speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing fatigue, weight loss, and jaundice. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old male. The patient complains of persistent fatigue and reports poor sleep quality. He mentions adopting a vegetarian diet in recent months to improve his energy levels but hasn't noticed significant benefits. The patient reports losing weight without trying over the last month.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatocellular Carcinoma (secondary to undiagnosed cirrhosis, likely alcoholic etiology given the clinical picture of weight loss, fatigue, jaundice, and age).
